jobs.prompt:
Delta review of hotfix 1.167.33 for Project Swarm, on top of 1.167.32 (22411782). The combined code diff is in context at coordination/review/hotfix-1167-33.diff; the browser evidence is in hotfix-1167-33-evidence.json; the full suite passed (7643 tests, 7612 pass, 0 fail) and the new browser test passed. The workspace files are not readable in your sandbox; judge from these.

Owner bug: the Command Center could not scroll on 1.167.32. Root cause: body.cc-body.hive-body in tools/watch-assets/command-center.css was locked to the viewport (min-height:100vh; max-height:100vh; overflow:hidden), so wheel, trackpad, touch, PageDown and Space did nothing (Hive content 1621 px at 1440x900, 2306 at 800x900, 3151 at 390x844). At 800 px the Hive shell also sized to its 1320 px max-content and the ring/card layout only switched below 900 px, causing horizontal overflow.

The hotfix: removes the body lock (height auto, max-height none, overflow-x hidden, overflow-y auto); makes .hive-shell width:100%/min-width:0 with max-width 1320; moves the card-grid/ring breakpoint from 900 to 1340 in cc-hive.css and sets PHONE_MAX=1340 in cc-hive-mount.js so the JS geometry matches; leaves the 1600 px ellipse layout unchanged; adds a real browser scroll test at 1600x900, 1280x800, 800x900 and 390x844 for Hive and Cockpit that asserts scrollWidth === clientWidth and exercises wheel, touch (all viewports) and keyboard to the last card and back; bumps to 1.167.33.

Look hard at: any remaining vertical lock or overflow:hidden that still traps content on either page (including the Cockpit worker stream/ticket stack and the Hive panels below the fold); the 1340 px boundary (a page at 1340/1341 must not jump into horizontal overflow or a broken ring/card layout); CSS/JS breakpoint mismatch (PHONE_MAX vs the media query); the shell width fix breaking the 1600 desktop ellipse or the centering; the ring/canvas geometry in the grid layout; horizontal overflow from the header/legend/panels; test false positives (programmatic scrollTo instead of real wheel/touch, networkidle, unconditional tour dismissal, wrong viewport, last-card selector missing); keyboard scrolling; the version bump and changelog accuracy; and any regression to the existing smoke test or the train 8 live feed. Report only real findings with file and line, a concrete failure, and a fix.

Write ONLY coordination/review/hotfix-1167-33-review.json: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","score":0-10,"blockers":[{"file":"","line":0,"problem":"","exploit_or_failure":"","fix":""}],"followups":[same shape],"summary":""}. verdict is fail only if blockers is non-empty.
